name: EEA/EFTA Right of Residence

requirements.blocker_text: EEA/EFTA citizens (EU states plus Norway, Liechtenstein, Switzerland) may reside in Iceland without a residence permit.

Must register with Registers Iceland (Thjodskra) once resident beyond the threshold period, obtaining an Icelandic ID number (kennitala) and legal domicile status. General processing time up to 10 working days.

evidence_required.document: Valid EEA/EFTA ID card or passport

outcome.duration_length: registration is not time-limited, subject to continuing residence

sources.title: Island.is -- Registration of EEA/EFTA Foreign Nationals: registration with Registers Iceland, Icelandic ID number, 10-working-day processing
